title: hackelia hendersonii
intro: Hackelia hendersonii, commonly known as Henderson's stickseed, is a flowering plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is native to the western United States and has been used in traditional herbal medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents in Hackelia hendersonii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
